note: The owner's list of 6 Oct (horseracebase's system builder v4, about 800 criteria; reports/hrb_system_builder_review.md): nearly all are the model's already. Two blocks carry the rest. inrunning (ir_, 13): each past run's in-running low and high from Betfair's price files (log low, low/BSP, high/BSP over the last run, 3, 5 weighted and career; the share of beaten runs that traded at 2.0 or less), the hidden in-running form RESEARCH_FRAMEWORK 6.2 named and never put before the served model. hrb_extras (hx_, 7): same surname, the share of seconds, the last race's winner's BSP and non-finishers, the biggest field won in, last year's run at the course and trip. main_ir and main_hx are the served main (the base, cached) plus each block at the served recipe, scored on the price forecast, the rule and the owner's staking (GBP250 to win at expected CLV >= 0/3/5%).
